mechanism: Both drugs are hepatic metabolizers via CYP450 enzymes (disulfiram inhibits CYP3A4/CYP2C9; terbinafine is metabolized by CYP2D6/CYP3A4), with potential for increased terbinafine levels and hepatotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor liver function tests and terbinafine efficacy; consider alternative antifungal if hepatic impairment exists; counsel on alcohol avoidance with disulfiram.
